These small droids are widespread. The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that varied widely in form and function. Some of them are at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogating, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

Almost all are under one meter tall. They are equipped either with wheeled legs or small repulsorlift generators for movement, and painted the colours of their owner or simply left unadorned.

A broad human woman with cropped dark hair and a perpetually grease-smudged brow. Her shop smells of durasteel dust and heated synth leather. A shelf of armor plates, helmets, and reinforced flight suits hang in the stall behind her. Ressa believes armor should save your life, not make a statement. Though she'll grudgingly add custom paint if paid enough.

Tall, lean, and carefully styled, this vendor dresses as well as anything he sells. The storage bins and racks that surround him are filled with a variety of tailored jackets, practical wear, and various adaptable garments for any climate. He frequently claims his clothes keep people alive just as often as Ressa's armors just by simple virtue of preventing them from getting shot in the first place.
This Cathar stands by a cart full of sweets, treats, and snacks.
This ugnaught has a stern look of disappointing and disapproval for any who does not buy her delicious-smelling treats.
With a winning smile and a gregarious disposition, this Zabrak stands behind a stall filled with knock-off brands of holocommunicators and other techno-gadgets.

Tucked away in a corner amongst the bustling din of the Trade Concourse a pair of adjoining shops run by a long-lived couple who have somehow managed to survive both the chaos of the galaxy and each other's strong opinions.

NO REFUNDS

You will lose the perk and all perk levels. All SP spent on the perk purchases will be refunded. You may immediately spend this SP on another perk purchase.
